purpose: Supplemental source verification of displayed H50 primary/role annotations; no change to frozen requested Bill set or expectations.
sparql:
PREFIX a: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology#>
PREFIX m: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology/members#>
PREFIX f: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX s: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX dl: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/eli-draft-legislation-ontology#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?bill ?primary ?role WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?person a a:Member; f:name "Catherine Connolly". } FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?g), "https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/member/")) GRAPH ?bg {?bill a dl:DraftLegislationWork. ?delivery dl:created_a_realization_of ?bill; dl:forms_part_of ?process. ?process dl:had_participation ?participation. ?participation dl:had_participant_person ?person.} FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?bg), "https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/bill/"))  OPTIONAL {GRAPH ?bg {?participation a:isPrimarySponsor ?primary.}} OPTIONAL {GRAPH ?bg {?participation <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> ?role.}} } ORDER BY ?bill ?primary ?role
